# Azure SQL Developer Hub

> Build applications on Azure SQL Database with an AI coding agent. Create a free database, paste a build prompt into your agent, and check the app against the list each prompt ends with. Built for AI workloads: native vector search, embeddings in T-SQL, JSON, and row-level security.

_Last updated: November 2026._

> Every page on this site has a markdown twin at the same path with `.md`. The whole site in one file is at /llms-full.txt.

## Start here
- [Get a database](https://microsoft.github.io/azure-sql-dev-hub/#get-running): create a free Azure SQL database, or run the local container.
- [Skills](https://aka.ms/azuresql-skills): the Microsoft SQL agent skills, with per-agent install commands.
- [Container: get started](https://microsoft.github.io/azure-sql-dev-hub/container/get-started.md): run the Azure SQL Database container with Docker, Podman, or WSL containers, connect, and troubleshoot.
- [Container FAQ](https://microsoft.github.io/azure-sql-dev-hub/container/faq.md): what the container includes and leaves out, and moving to Azure.

## App prompts
Each is a specification: rules, sample data, the database design, and checks. They run on an Azure SQL Database or on the local container.
- [Team board](https://microsoft.github.io/azure-sql-dev-hub/build/team-board.md): combined filters, due dates, edit conflicts, and change history with temporal tables.
- [Inventory reservations](https://microsoft.github.io/azure-sql-dev-hub/build/inventory-reservations.md): reserve stock under concurrent orders without overselling, with idempotent retries and an audit trail.
- [Knowledge base search](https://microsoft.github.io/azure-sql-dev-hub/build/knowledge-base.md): search articles by meaning with `VECTOR`, `VECTOR_DISTANCE`, and embeddings generated in T-SQL. Needs an embedding model.
- [Revenue reporting](https://microsoft.github.io/azure-sql-dev-hub/build/revenue-reporting.md): exact money math in integer cents, partial refunds, and totals that count each sale once.
- [Shipment tracker](https://microsoft.github.io/azure-sql-dev-hub/build/shipment-tracker.md): import event batches atomically with `OPENJSON`, catch duplicates and conflicts, and order late events the same way on every run.
- [Multi-tenant helpdesk](https://microsoft.github.io/azure-sql-dev-hub/build/multi-tenant-helpdesk.md): tenant isolation in the API and with row-level security, role checks, and safe connection reuse.

## Building-block prompts
Short, step-by-step additions with the code included. They target Azure SQL Database in the cloud unless noted.
- [Start a Next.js app](https://microsoft.github.io/azure-sql-dev-hub/build/javascript-app.md): JavaScript. A read-only task page with Microsoft Entra sign-in.
- [Add a Python API](https://microsoft.github.io/azure-sql-dev-hub/build/python-api.md): Python. A FastAPI service that lists, creates, and completes tasks.
- [Search text by meaning](https://microsoft.github.io/azure-sql-dev-hub/build/rag-app.md): Python. Embeddings in a `VECTOR` column, ranked with `VECTOR_DISTANCE`.
- [Add a serverless API](https://microsoft.github.io/azure-sql-dev-hub/build/serverless-api.md): .NET. Azure Functions with the SQL input and output bindings.
- [React to data changes](https://microsoft.github.io/azure-sql-dev-hub/build/event-driven-app.md): .NET. The Azure Functions SQL trigger with Change Tracking. Builds on the serverless API.
- [Isolate each tenant's rows](https://microsoft.github.io/azure-sql-dev-hub/build/multi-tenant.md): JavaScript. Row-level security keyed on `SESSION_CONTEXT`. Builds on the Next.js app.
- [Get a REST and GraphQL API](https://microsoft.github.io/azure-sql-dev-hub/build/data-api.md): Data API builder over a table, read-only by default. Cloud or local container.
- [Move from the container to the cloud](https://microsoft.github.io/azure-sql-dev-hub/build/local-to-cloud.md): switch a local app to Azure SQL Database with Microsoft Entra sign-in.

## Key facts
- Free tier: each database gets 100,000 vCore seconds, 32 GB of data, and 32 GB of backup storage a month, for up to 10 databases per subscription. Create one at https://aka.ms/azuresqlhub by selecting Start free. With the Azure CLI, `az sql db create` needs `--use-free-limit true`; without it the database is billable.
- A free-tier database pauses after 15 minutes idle. The first connection after a pause can return error 40613 and succeeds on retry.
- Connect to Azure SQL Database with Microsoft Entra; never a password in code or config. `mssql` (Node) uses `authentication: { type: "azure-active-directory-default" }`; `Microsoft.Data.SqlClient` (.NET) uses `Authentication=Active Directory Default`; `mssql-python` takes a `DefaultAzureCredential` from `azure-identity` as its token provider.
- AI: native `VECTOR` type, `VECTOR_DISTANCE`, `AI_GENERATE_EMBEDDINGS` with `CREATE EXTERNAL MODEL`, and `AI_GENERATE_CHUNKS`, which needs compatibility level 170. From a client, pass a vector as a JSON array in an `NVARCHAR(MAX)` parameter and cast it to `VECTOR(n)`; a long embedding sent as ntext fails with error 529.
- Event-driven: the Azure Functions SQL trigger requires Change Tracking on the database and the table. Output bindings upsert with `MERGE` and need a primary key and compatibility level 130 or higher.
- Multi-tenant: row-level security with a filter predicate and block predicates keyed on `SESSION_CONTEXT`, set per unit of work on one connection and cleared before the connection returns to the pool.
- Local development: the Azure SQL Database container runs the same engine offline. Public preview; pull `mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/azure-sql-db-server:latest`, no sign-up needed. It does not include Change Tracking, Change Data Capture, auditing, Always Encrypted, or ledger; see the container FAQ for the full list.

## Optional
- [Repository](https://github.com/microsoft/azure-sql-dev-hub), short link https://aka.ms/azuresql-hub
- [Install the agent skills](https://aka.ms/azuresql-skills). Claude Code: `claude plugin marketplace add microsoft/microsoft-sql` then `claude plugin install microsoft-sql@microsoft-sql`. GitHub Copilot CLI: `copilot plugin marketplace add microsoft/microsoft-sql` then `copilot plugin install microsoft-sql@microsoft-sql`. Codex: `codex plugin marketplace add microsoft/microsoft-sql --ref main` then `codex plugin add microsoft-sql@microsoft-sql`. Cursor: `cursor-agent plugin marketplace add https://github.com/microsoft/microsoft-sql`, then install from `/plugin`.
